content: U sakwa yise ka Te Naa besa unnepu numu tunedyooe.
Mu wakwa'etse tuukwena umu sakwa besa'yookuna, besa tutusooyugwena, gi pumme ne'emukwa-wa'ne'yoo. Te Naa-wi tubetse tunaka'oedyukudu, no'oko numu soobesa'yookuna ka Te Naa besa podo meadabe.
U sakwa mu pepeawabe tuwazoo tuukwe'e, umuoo sakwa punno'o ooosapa nanesootuhi, ooosapa besa tumatuguna, gi tunesootzepana, gi baagoepana, ka hemma besow numu tunedyooe.
Umu sakwa mu momoko'ne meeoo tunedyooe, meeoo mu netammana, “Mu koomamu besa soobedyana, mu doodooamu tuwazoo too besa mabetseana,
gi kumma'akoosoo ma'emukwakupana, mu nobe besa mabetseana, besa numu matuguna, tu koomma nakabetseana, o'no yise mu numu Te Naa besa unnepu nesookwuga.”
U sakwa mu pudu nanana tuwazoo meeoo tuukwe'e, “Gi nanema'emukwapana gi tusoomatzooepana.”
U sakwa ooosapa besa tumatugu, u ka Te Naa besa podo meano'o, o'no yise umu u-kwa'nesoo. U sakwa mu numu tubetse tunedyooe.
Soo u unnekwuna sakwa besa'yoo, o'no mu numu gi te netumoo'oona, te nesootzemakwu.
No'yoona mu numu ka hemma how yugwena sakwa ka pumme nedyawedu nakabetsea. Umu hemma how yugwedu sakwa besa mu masokwamana gi umu-no sukwe nahapana.
Umu sakwa gi hemma umu-makoo tuduhapana, o'no mu numu Te Naa unnepu nesoogwuga'ekwu.

Soo Te Naa besa unnepu no'obatusoo numu-baa nanaka petugapu, soo Te Naa ka pumme naka'oedyukudu sootuhina, mu magwetzoa'e tooe gi besa mu tumatuguse sapa, soo Te Naa ka suda mu tumatuguna soomu'wakwu.

Te Naa unnepu meeoo te tunedyoo'e, ka sutakoo po ma'wukase, ka suta mu manena soomu'wa. Ooonne'yoona sakwa tamme kaaheno ka Te Naa podo mea, ooosapa besa tumatuguna, gi nane'emukwapupana, gi tusoomatzooepana ka yow teepu-kooba'yoona.
Ka Te Pabe'e kodyu petukwuna tamme sookwa'e, mee tamme nanesootuhiyakwe.
Ka Te Pabe'e Jesus tamme-koobatoo nabatsase, oosoo te ma'emukwana soomu'wase, besa gi totsabu te mayugwe, tu doodooamu te mayugwe. O'no yise tamme ooosapa besa tumatugumokwu.

Yooonnekoo hekwitu sakwa u numu tunedyooe. Mu tunaka'oedyukudu nenoyukwena, mu ume gi nakabetseadu kaaheno nemayugwe, u ka mu moohena. Mu numu sakwa saa'a gi u-ma'yoona nanekoepana ka meeoo pumme u tuukwe'e.
